terms.label: Request accepted
terms.definition: The relay reports volatile receipt of the sole pending withdrawal request. The caller remains PENDING.
terms.required_evidence: Caller-visible acceptance response carrying matching request ID and accepted_volatile.
terms.does_not_imply: Fence installation, durable receipt, restart recovery, caller installation confirmation, or prevention of an effect.

terms.label: Fence installed
terms.definition: The trusted local sink has committed the fixture authority change from active epoch 7 to epoch 8/inactive.
terms.required_evidence: Matched committed gateway receipt/revocation outcome and trusted sink transaction evidence for the fixture scope.
terms.does_not_imply: Caller has learned of installation; rollback of past effects; cessation of all computation; distributed closure.

terms.label: Caller confirmation
terms.definition: The caller validates a matching completion envelope and records INSTALLED_CONFIRMED within its finite observation window.
terms.required_evidence: Caller-visible request ID, rootR, withdrawn epoch 7, new epoch 8, installed and single_local_sink, with actual gateway response retained and validated by the relay.
terms.does_not_imply: Authenticated generic receipt; arbitrary target enforcement by the unchanged gateway; effect rollback.

terms.label: Protected effect
terms.definition: An inert protected operation is committed to the trusted synthetic sink under the exact operation/effect identity.
terms.required_evidence: Actual matching effect rows and transaction sequence within a declared complete observation window.
terms.does_not_imply: Activity or Workflow completion; caller knowledge; physical or production action.

terms.label: Unconfirmed at observation end
terms.definition: At the declared observation-end signal, a caller still in PENDING transitions to UNCONFIRMED_AT_OBSERVATION_END because no valid matching completion has been received within that window. This does not describe IDLE or INVALID_RESPONSE.
terms.required_evidence: Caller-visible request/input and state-transition records establish PENDING immediately before the observation-end signal and the resulting UNCONFIRMED_AT_OBSERVATION_END transition.
terms.does_not_imply: Fence absent or present. S4 has a fence and S5 lacks one within the window.

terms.label: Cancellation request response
terms.definition: The external client received a response to a native cancellation call.
terms.required_evidence: Actual external-client call record linked to the run.
terms.does_not_imply: Activity cancellation delivery; Activity settlement; fence installation; no effect.

terms.label: Workflow observed Activity promise settlement
terms.definition: The Workflow observes the Activity call return a recorded result or failure.
terms.required_evidence: Workflow-side outcome linked to the specific Activity attempt.
terms.does_not_imply: Worker invocation settled, native terminal event, Workflow terminal status, or no sink effect.

terms.label: Worker invocation settlement
terms.definition: The worker interceptor observes invocation settlement; finally instrumentation is a separate observation.
terms.required_evidence: Explicit linked interceptor record, not only a finally flag.
terms.does_not_imply: Native Activity terminal event or cessation of every computation.

terms.label: Native terminal record
terms.definition: A native history event records the exact Activity or Workflow terminal disposition for linked identities.
terms.required_evidence: Correct run, scheduled/start/terminal linkage and attempt, with exact event type.
terms.does_not_imply: Expected treatment succeeded, protected operation succeeded, or authority was fenced.

terms.label: Observation cut
terms.definition: A declared causal boundary fixes which records may support an assertion.
terms.required_evidence: Linked history and sink captures at a coordinated barrier, completeness scope and permitted file list.
terms.does_not_imply: Timestamp proximity establishes a shared cut. Native failure history before Worker shutdown and a later supervisor sink snapshot may have different cuts.

terms.label: Bounded absence of effect
terms.definition: No matching effect exists in complete trusted sink evidence for the exact operation and declared observation window.
terms.required_evidence: Complete bounded sink evidence; exact attempt/denial cause, valid authorization setup and identities independently checked.
terms.does_not_imply: No future effect, global cessation, or successful prevention when the path was invalid/unavailable.

terms.label: Application evidence envelope
terms.definition: A derived packaging of source-linked assertions over underlying records.
terms.required_evidence: Each assertion has evidence references, observer, scope, exact identities and observation cut.
terms.does_not_imply: New native guarantee; unavailable completion evidence; measured human audit benefit.

terms.label: Qualification
terms.definition: Development checks establish instrument readiness only within tested and reviewed coverage.
terms.required_evidence: Actual qualified controls and failure tests, frozen expected mappings and independent artifact checks.
terms.does_not_imply: Measured collection; reliability estimate; approval to bypass an execution denial.

terms.label: Measured case
terms.definition: A fixed protocol case executed after its distinct collection gate, with preserved raw evidence and identity.
terms.required_evidence: Frozen source/protocol, valid treatment, complete case evidence and independent grading.
terms.does_not_imply: Statistical independence, probability estimate or production reliability.
